# Code Quiz Game - Copilot Instructions

This is a Flutter mobile game project with the following specifications:

## Tech Stack
- Flutter/Dart
- Firebase (Firestore, Authentication)
- Material Design 3
- Google Fonts for modern typography

## Project Structure
- `lib/models/` - Data models (User, Question, Score)
- `lib/screens/` - UI screens (Login, Profile, Game, etc.)
- `lib/widgets/` - Reusable widgets
- `lib/services/` - Firebase and business logic services
- `lib/utils/` - Utilities and constants

## Code Style
- Use modern Flutter best practices
- Implement Material Design 3 theming
- Use StatefulWidget/StatelessWidget appropriately
- Follow Dart naming conventions (camelCase for variables, PascalCase for classes)
- Add Turkish language support in comments where helpful

## Game Logic
- User authentication (static for now, Firebase later)
- Programming language selection: C#, SQL, Python, JavaScript
- Quiz with code snippets
- 3 lives system
- Score tracking
- Correct/Wrong button system

## UI/UX Guidelines
- Modern, colorful, user-friendly interface
- Smooth animations and transitions
- Responsive design for mobile devices
- Clear visual feedback for user actions
